messages:
sam_support: Customer on Dedicated reported intermittent 500s from /v1/functions/call when using JSON mode for function/tool calls. They say runtime sometimes returns 'invalid function args: missing items' even though their schema marks items as required. Any recent regressions?

derek_eng: Do we have the exact request payload they sent? Could be double-encoded nested 'items' or a coercion bug.

sam_support: Pasted sanitized sample from customer (they insist they send items as an empty array):
```json
{"function":"create_order","args":"{\"order_id\":\"abc123\",\"items\":null}"}
```
Logs on our side show args.items === null on parse, and the runtime returns 500 during the tool invocation. They also reported a CPU spike on their dedicated pool.

lia_pm: :eyes: Is this possibly related to the JSONMODE parsing change we rolled last week that touched stringified args? Paging eng-runtime.

derek_eng: Reproduced locally: if client sends args as a string (stringified JSON) the args path goes through safe-unwrap -> we attempt to parse twice in one codepath. For stringified empty arrays we end up coercing to null in the second parse. That's the mismatch w/ the declared schema (items required array). The runtime then surfaces an internal 500 instead of validating and returning a 4xx.

sre_bot: deploy-bot: rolled back inference-runtime from v2.14.3 -> v2.14.2 on pool rdedicated-us-west-2 at 17:42 UTC (canary 10% stable).

derek_eng: Root cause: double-parse + qcache path for string args. Fix plan: add idempotent safeParse, run schema validation right after parse, and convert 500 -> 400 for schema violations. Working on PR now.

sam_support: Customer asked for ETA and whether any of their orders were corrupted/lost. They also saw extra billing from client retries.

derek_eng: No data loss — we didn't persist failing requests. The 500 caused client retries which produced extra token usage. We'll offer a billing credit and deploy hotfix. Patch PR #3482, tests added for stringified args + empty array cases. ETA: hotfix canary in ~90m, full rollout in ~2h if canary is clean.

lia_pm: OK. Sam, prepare a support message: apology, explanation (parsing bug in runtime that caused 500s for stringified args), credit for extra token usage, and short workaround (send args as structured JSON body not string). I'll coordinate the credit approval.

sam_support: Will draft reply. Thanks all — will follow up after canary. :thumbsup:
